name: JP
quote_en:
I couldn’t have asked for a better real estate agent to guide me through my first home purchase. Gevitha was incredibly professional, patient, and always made me feel like my best interests were her top priority.

Her attention to detail truly stood out. During house visits, she would spot potential concerns like piping or structural issues that we may have otherwise missed until inspection. Her knowledge, care, and dedication gave me confidence every step of the way.

What makes Gevitha even more special is her genuine desire to help people avoid the challenges she has experienced herself. She truly goes above and beyond for her clients.

Thank you, Gevitha, for making my first home-buying experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable. I highly recommend (and I have already recommended) her to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring real estate professional!

name: Anisan Gunam
quote_en: Just bought a condo in Saint-Laurent with Gevitha and honestly had a great experience. She’s really good at spotting solid deals that fit what you're looking for. What I appreciated most was her negotiation skills—she actually fights for a good price and doesn't just try to close the deal quickly. Super happy with how it turned out. Definitely recommend her if you're looking to buy.
